team.name: Tracey Hornbeck
team.title: President & CEO
intro: As President & CEO of Legacy Trust, Tracey is responsible for all aspects of business, including strategic planning, P&L responsibilities, shareholder relations, employee and client engagement. Before joining Legacy Trust, Tracey built her career in a large regional bank most recently serving as Regional Chief Financial Officer and Senior Vice President. In this role, she had financial oversight for a multi-state region of more than $16 billion in assets and more than 3,000 employees in Michigan, Indiana, Missouri, and Northwest Ohio. Tracey’s achievements have earned her recognition as a Top Woman in Finance, Regional Thought Leader, YWCA Women of Achievement, Inforum Inner Circle Leader, and named 40 Under 40 by the Grand Rapids Business Journal. She was also named among the publication’s Top 200 Business leaders in West Michigan during its inaugural year in 2019 and again in 2020 to 2025. Most recently, GRBJ also recognized her as one of West Michigan’s 50 Most Influential Women. And Crain’s Magazine Detroit named her among the 50 Most Notable Women in Banking.

team.name: Melanie VanderHoff
team.title: Senior Vice President, Director of Operations & Risk Management
intro: As Senior Vice President and Director of Operations & Risk Management, Melanie oversees operations, technology and compliance. In 2003, she was one of five founding members of Legacy Trust and was responsible for establishing the corporate structure, setting up systems, operation workflows, human resources and benefits. Melanie’s role with the firm has evolved over time. She has been key to providing leadership in the development of not only the company’s operations but compliance and technology and has effectively led the team to deliver exceptional operations utilizing “best in class” technology all while adhering to strict regulatory requirements. Melanie began her career at Old Kent Bank, later Fifth Third Bank, where she landed in Trust Operations and realized this was truly her passion. The detailed, client focused, technical nature of operations lined up with Melanie’s personality. She held several positions throughout her career at Fifth Third, with Assistant Vice President and Trust Securities Manager being the most recent.

team.name: Steven Doorn, CFA
team.title: Senior Vice President, Chief Investment Officer
intro: As the Chief Investment Officer, Steve leads the development, execution and oversight of the firm’s investment philosophy and asset management strategies, including asset allocation guidelines, tactical positioning, portfolio construction and investment policy design. Steve also plays a vital role in the design and management of Legacy’s Core Equity strategy, leading the firm’s company research functions and portfolio construction. Steve has over 25 years of investment management experience working with clients throughout the United States.

team.name: Kelly DeRidder, CTFA®
team.title: Senior Vice President, Senior Wealth Advisor
intro: Kelly is a Senior Wealth Advisor with over 30 years of experience managing complex client relationships and guiding individuals and families through some of life’s most important financial decisions. Kelly brings deep expertise in trust and estate administration and wealth transfer strategies across multiple generations. Throughout her career, she has helped families preserve wealth, navigate fiduciary responsibilities, and implement thoughtful plans that align financial assets with family values and long-term goals.

Known for a highly personalized and consultative approach, Kelly works closely with clients and their professional advisors to simplify complexity, anticipate challenges, and ensure continuity across generations. Clients value her ability to balance technical expertise with empathy, discretion, and unwavering attention to detail.
Above all, Kelly is trusted as a partner, focused on protecting legacies, facilitating smooth transitions, and helping families move confidently from one generation to the next.

team.name: Brian Moore, MBA, CFP®, CTFA®
team.title: Senior Vice President, Senior Wealth Advisor
intro: As a Senior Wealth Advisor, Brian focuses primarily on relationship management and delivering comprehensive wealth planning services to executive and high net worth clients. He brings significant expertise in sophisticated wealth management strategies focused on creating tax efficiency for the accumulation, preservation and transition of family financial resources. Prior to joining Legacy Trust in 2003, Brian spent many years providing wealth planning and trust administration at Old Kent Bank, later Fifth Third Bank. Brian left Legacy Trust in 2016 to manage wealth management teams in other cities, but soon found himself missing West Michigan and the freedom to focus on the holistic process of helping people find solutions to their most difficult financial concerns. He is happy to be home again in Grand Rapids and at Legacy Trust.

team.name: Jeff Steeby, CFP®, ATFA
team.title: Senior Vice President, Senior Wealth Advisor
intro: Jeff is a Senior Wealth Advisor with more than 35 years of experience in investment management and trust administration. He is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional and an Accredited Trust and Fiduciary Advisor, with extensive expertise in wealth planning, estate planning, trust administration, and investment management.

Jeff is dedicated to delivering exceptional client service by simplifying financial complexity and helping clients clearly understand their financial position and long‑term goals. Through ongoing communication and thoughtful plan adjustments, he ensures clients feel confident in their strategy and peace of mind moving forward. Jeff is passionate about educating clients and believes deeply in Legacy Trust’s team‑based approach, leveraging specialized expertise to provide comprehensive, well‑rounded solutions.

team.name: Bill Harrison, CFP®
team.title: Wealth Advisor
intro: As a Wealth Advisor, Bill partners with high-net-worth individuals and families to navigate complex financial decisions and develop integrated wealth strategies designed to support long-term goals across generations. His experience spans comprehensive wealth planning, investment strategy, estate and wealth transfer planning coordination, tax-efficient planning, and retirement planning for affluent families and business owners.

Before joining Legacy Trust in 2026, Bill advised high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients at Plante Moran Financial Advisors, where he worked alongside tax, estate, and investment specialists to deliver coordinated planning solutions for complex client situations. Through this collaborative approach, he developed a strong foundation in aligning sophisticated financial strategies with each client’s broader personal and family objectives.

Bill is a CFP® professional who is committed to delivering thoughtful guidance, proactive communication, and a high level of personalized service. He values long-term relationships built on trust, clarity, and a deep understanding of each client’s unique priorities and legacy goals.

team.name: Greg Barshied, CFA
team.title: Portfolio Manager
intro: As Portfolio Manager, Greg is responsible for the management of client portfolio assets within their established investment objectives. He is also responsible for conducting equity research in support of the company’s proprietary Core Equity strategy. He monitors current holdings of the Core Equity strategy, while sourcing ideas for potential additions or deletions. Greg serves as a member of the company’s investment committee, contributing to decisions on market outlook, investment policy design, asset allocation, model portfolio construction, and third-party manager engagements for specialty asset classes that complement the firm’s proprietary equity strategy.

team.name: Andrew Otten
team.title: Associate Portfolio Manager
intro: Andrew serves as Associate Portfolio Manager and is responsible for the management of client portfolio assets within established investment objectives. The investment objectives are designed in collaboration with clients and other members of Legacy Trust’s team to fit each client’s specific goals. Andrew also serves as a member of the investment committee contributing to market outlook, portfolio construction and asset allocation.
Andrew is a native to West Michigan and enjoys a variety of outdoor activities with his wife and daughter.

team.name: Gavin Anderson, CIMA®
team.title: Performance Analyst
intro: Gavin has over a decade of experience at Legacy Trust and currently serves the Investment Team in the role of Performance Analyst, evaluating third party managers, asset allocation and providing detailed portfolio reporting to the internal team and to the firm’s clients. Additionally, he is responsible for analyzing firm-wide financial data and for preparing reporting for the internal leadership team as well as the firm’s Board and regulators. As a member of Legacy Trust’s Engagement Committee, he helps organize volunteer and employee events for the office.

team.name: Collin Hartley, CFP®

He is detail-oriented, solution-focused, and values collaboration as a way to bring clarity and confidence to the planning process.
Collin is a West Michigan native who enjoys spending time on the lake and golfing at local courses.
